Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Notre-Dame de Paris", "unit": 54, "heading": "IV\nUN MALADROIT AMI", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr86-u054-b0076", "target": "Герцог Египетский печально показал ему два потока кипящего свинца, не переставая бороздивших чёрный фасад, словно две длинные прялки из фосфора. — Бывали церкви, которые так сами себя защищали, — заметил он со вздохом. — Святая София в Константинополе, сорок лет тому назад, три раза подряд сбросила наземь полумесяц Магомета, потрясая своими куполами, которые суть её головы. Гийом Парижский, построивший эту церковь, был волшебником.", "source_sha256": "816b9ebbfe5a0698daf5a1ceddcef47ee70a137b29725b523a7ad040d20b86ba", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u054-b0076", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "da9c34d62a9e803941cd12a2e8c516cf98b5a422975e20fab38687c8916255c1"}, {"source_id": "fr86-u054-b0077", "target": "— Так что же, уходить жалко, как лакеи с большой дороги? — сказал Клопен. — Бросить здесь нашу сестру, которую эти волки в капюшонах повесят завтра!", "source_sha256": "4c49f201ac481533cf628e6feaff0dde9ed06718b3b896bc4e0f26f470080643", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u054-b0077", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "a8bb8dde30e9a935734b282e2a1e9f36883b61db683a079e92ecd01073e7ec6a"}], "source_language": "French", "part": null, "book": 10, "chapter": 4, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr86-u054-b0078", "text": "—Et la sacristie, où il y a des charretées d'or! ajouta un truand dont nous regrettons de ne pas savoir le nom.", "sha256": "9953b6d32351669be82c094056c616f7e03cc94ddb7d1d35c06bc4bc7a0e4867", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3247], "source_xml_sha256": "8c3bdba5f60181cfa7ff7d4c92fbaf041b789a83cf9a7534d98624547b908b9e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0079", "text": "—Barbe-Mahom! cria Trouillefou.", "sha256": "29f8c92e389c7ea1b80a916a3ac6fa70248d923a600fa6a72fd6da4ca9988b49", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3248], "source_xml_sha256": "940854dd5487c382d9ee61dbdd980c01d9eba6791b5bae764c581f9871a0ea0d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0080", "text": "—Essayons encore une fois», reprit le truand.", "sha256": "8daf47972070da438ca6ec638a74c3d5d29e69c291f4a002db526ae979a6c2c9", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3249], "source_xml_sha256": "91d53986a0fc24ae7be6c4289b089c9f63130f94dcbc4145e9434bd92fea2a15", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0081", "text": "Mathias Hungadi hocha la tête.", "sha256": "2ca6d7ca033f5b02a88ed83dc7f30346b6bc50e7cc7a85d527266a9ddaf0234a", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3250], "source_xml_sha256": "17c492f2d091edf777e284ecfd99688e136312444ecaab77ac4f743ff85a381e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0082", "text": "«Nous n'entrerons pas par la porte. Il faut trouver le défaut de l'armure de la vieille fée. Un trou, une fausse poterne, une jointure quelconque.", "sha256": "31ec1b7677dfa71a4762e8010def80198058481e161cbbc0c573168b05eacf4f", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3251], "source_xml_sha256": "027d8de0b529a8ec1fc1e806c63bc76e4fb8b50b213b20cc201f41fe84ad1364", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0083", "text": "—Qui en est? dit Clopin. J'y retourne.—À propos, où est donc le petit écolier Jehan qui était si enferraillé?", "sha256": "8b3d568866ee34c2c3d1a7bb1c5eff3282f14a882543969247a83950146df26e", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3252], "source_xml_sha256": "433a3149c0c815bad786bd59541cd615ce86f612b354cbef30c9f5f5150ca567", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0084", "text": "—Il est sans doute mort, répondit quelqu'un. On ne l'entend plus rire.»", "sha256": "77354da541e376e4d700e75b2ad686aa34cd092056f5a9331f6a8cd2b579ac15", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3253], "source_xml_sha256": "1d7fea0377b9ae451db982da645ec19256e46e96765aa3cf3be85f2370be3735", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0085", "text": "Le roi de Thunes fronça le sourcil.", "sha256": "5ffc4c5fb16d50daef7562dddd039dbbbde11d291d5d407c49fb5d130a419846", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3254], "source_xml_sha256": "12024fbfb732d03dc3348dfa224b02a3267cd270bc5358f53b7f6152550f8b86", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0086", "text": "«Tant pis. Il y avait un brave cœur sous cette ferraille.—Et maître Pierre Gringoire?", "sha256": "38765a56c42a602b8b32c5d84ae30bfd06bcc2f64d61f03cb3dea2ccb1409b61", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3255], "source_xml_sha256": "46fe402b8f852fc85112c875367f95df5da829c6e4e79a9b0ba3cd122e864ce4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0087", "text": "—Capitaine Clopin, dit Andry le Rouge, il s'est esquivé que nous n'étions encore qu'au Pont-aux-Changeurs.»", "sha256": "0058fd8f98a8e5bd61a98e77183178a58327f813ec00a7e62642dcab217339d0", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3256], "source_xml_sha256": "fefd0b791a7bcbf57dcc2aae475c686975aeec72bfa52c0987ea7183e7479b6a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0088", "text": "Clopin frappa du pied. «Gueule-Dieu! c'est lui qui nous pousse céans, et il nous plante là au beau milieu de la besogne!—Lâche bavard, casqué d'une pantoufle!", "sha256": "390199455b7e93290ec86a2d0ca8df3c336cef3a43e07fd30a283f29221aba36", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3257], "source_xml_sha256": "889cdb75fcc2a50422123a2bf3ab6c8b2cd5d63ac332e8ee32004b8e1dade154", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0089", "text": "—Capitaine Clopin, cria Andry le Rouge, qui regardait dans la rue du Parvis, voilà le petit écolier.", "sha256": "a48979d0bdfdaa8e98ef69975d55bea457c76c85e69809fd6f4e2d90d930b1d3", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3258], "source_xml_sha256": "d565f2dee26b9e3f15540271554832c733e987f0b63fbc780fddf06aca0e2df3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0090", "text": "—Loué soit Pluto! dit Clopin. Mais que diable tire-t-il après lui?»", "sha256": "5e9dde94d38fe8b010a893ce9f05f07a702200c6341dd04ff4b171a9773bd3e9", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3259], "source_xml_sha256": "0ef56d6acfa48e9dd3cd1c999959459f581cc2999eca55a149a3cf6fbaa86639", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0091", "text": "C'était Jehan, en effet, qui accourait aussi vite que le lui permettaient ses lourds habits de paladin et une longue échelle qu'il traînait bravement sur le pavé, plus essoufflé qu'une fourmi attelée à un brin d'herbe vingt fois plus long qu'elle.", "sha256": "46cd6499d2b5068c484f106e37ba5ebe805895a37715b57082e2cb7dde0f2f03", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3260], "source_xml_sha256": "a12bdb163c2e81b201e652b36ff03a13801d4d5f4184b4742b6bc7641d114081", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0092", "text": "«Victoire! [[I]]Te Deum[[/I]]! criait l'écolier. Voilà l'échelle des déchargeurs du port Saint-Landry.»", "sha256": "7685290a9ce782fdee21eb76cb50c4cb9b424fb45343d74ebb96d9ec676cd1ea", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3261], "source_xml_sha256": "bcaedd806e3c55976d88c2aba812c8ebc4232c31fcb722f1f49c61a4b2f4593a", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0093", "text": "Clopin s'approcha de lui.", "sha256": "5a319d1ba162ad2c4e655e13347574a20e8f294e57e20cf83414f99e8fee76c8", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3262], "source_xml_sha256": "9f7eff9d6a1e34155f6405f9a6fe65e2e7853808f77858eaaacee8cc6ea67313", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0094", "text": "«Enfant! que veux-tu faire, corne-Dieu! de cette échelle?", "sha256": "48e2d3aa5fa0341a24c30e9cfb4dfdcbbbf1288ae91f065cceaebdd00671f40a", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3263], "source_xml_sha256": "3d0005760c87aeb53feaa3c16ca8642574ac766d9928d42ff1883aa49f10112e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0095", "text": "—Je l'ai, répondit Jehan haletant. Je savais où elle était.—Sous le hangar de la maison du lieutenant.—Il y a là une fille que je connais, qui me trouve beau comme un Cupido.—Je m'en suis servi pour avoir l'échelle, et j'ai l'échelle, Pasque-Mahom!—La pauvre fille est venue m'ouvrir toute en chemise.", "sha256": "8f6f58b47e650b3fb3fb2d44a60cd97baa4312bfa38b7bee50b8f74569cb56bb", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3264], "source_xml_sha256": "e633e4331837e13c75a1c9e251fc6315edffbcc366be58f775485086d84fcf6b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0096", "text": "—Oui, dit Clopin, mais que veux-tu faire de cette échelle?»", "sha256": "736e39444e2b69a4b0e7b935cd4d70b8c11103a08dcd3928f3e8ef98235e579b", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3265], "source_xml_sha256": "f9ce78c59a4bcd9d2c61cf5997a0ecd4249ef1e8088fb2fae1e372e74e00ca1e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0097", "text": "Jehan le regarda d'un air malin et capable, et fit claquer ses doigts comme des castagnettes. Il était sublime en ce moment. Il avait sur la tête un de ces casques surchargés du quinzième siècle, qui épouvantaient l'ennemi de leurs cimiers chimériques. Le sien était hérissé de dix becs de fer, de sorte que Jehan eût pu disputer la redoutable épithète de [[N126]] au navire homérique de Nestor.", "sha256": "1e5f6eb97be578c80ec544483a1ffdfaf1d63c5fb8ff0aca358564f1771ce067", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3266], "source_xml_sha256": "054be4e2b33f7ee9ededcafafa45064fdcc042bbfb7ab3963d4758345a6495ef", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": ["[[N126]]"]}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0098", "text": "«Ce que j'en veux faire, auguste roi de Thunes? Voyez-vous cette rangée de statues qui ont des mines d'imbéciles là-bas au-dessus des trois portails?", "sha256": "09a5b335f502fa57c157f5f17886322c8829505040dfac5d5e8591ab6b6ba480", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3267], "source_xml_sha256": "851be5ae965923bfe5d5b98d00e1f273e7b15dda54121f9ad91c75193a2fe4e3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0099", "text": "—Oui. Eh bien?", "sha256": "ca84b4fe4fd5e85dd893ccc8171362324726701da592c007a6e6da30799688f4", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3268], "source_xml_sha256": "0ad20102fa0ae6d040898ed164a7551f07d0d3155d47a4315c2c1806707f62b8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0100", "text": "—C'est la galerie des rois de France!", "sha256": "789d618f0f84234a54d68f422464440e873f7f6d6c986b1a83f25f11ef2dec7f", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3269], "source_xml_sha256": "31b4d3206d40679af9e5ec2aac1298be9822d996e529236e1b68cc912a9bb7f1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0101", "text": "—Qu'est-ce que cela me fait? dit Clopin.", "sha256": "958363d03c19d16ab805d9b3f6240611c72cf18f0e3d562872da83de4f4f34a3", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3270], "source_xml_sha256": "d9b1e4b47921353aef9a04925717c8bf8d57e7bb1a2a95cf80d60f019a4525fa", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0102", "text": "—Attendez donc! Il y a au bout de cette galerie une porte qui n'est jamais fermée qu'au loquet, avec cette échelle j'y monte, et je suis dans l'église.", "sha256": "5c0178435298893f499f3c33f2ce91fda6db36f3995c36844261694d0b1b6d5d", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3271], "source_xml_sha256": "e8d2ee0dddcdd1737849498fa114b0946288cab5974f00d1f6f3bc4ac5ad8325", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0103", "text": "—Enfant, laisse-moi monter le premier.", "sha256": "d45ce64e7c32b14f4d782276e5d96c8ffbcdb9080e6741dfe22ea430ba0b92bc", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3272], "source_xml_sha256": "3bd2cf34ccc5cf5e30601eb7cdf1f7b4b16a644e3dbe98bcea896a2acfc0ecc8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0104", "text": "—Non pas, camarade, c'est à moi l'échelle. Venez, vous serez le second.", "sha256": "faeb2456b9724c151d4dfc44125c29f534bad083d2e285744fb00be15e59bc32", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3273], "source_xml_sha256": "fb69536aaaee24106d8c57a77821493df31d14373603ca40914dbe1f358cd6dc", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0105", "text": "—Que Belzébuth t'étrangle! dit le bourru Clopin. Je ne veux être après personne.", "sha256": "c2861fd3d9e1bf24938432203b4954722ad9fcf02f3c8ea52b5b40b915d90920", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3274], "source_xml_sha256": "cca74bc93677a85962a92d822aa7c9a5607538179fd9a55531243bfbc1e4b4d7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0106", "text": "—Alors, Clopin, cherche une échelle!»", "sha256": "083726b4f6c69d3f257875f7a910107fdc525f5c2e9eb0ff7efbaedec2afa44c", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3275], "source_xml_sha256": "ee15481981c0b28d17ddbb65621bc65d999ebea0c546cee075e0cccce055a2f0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0107", "text": "Jehan se mit à courir par la place, tirant son échelle et criant: «À moi les fils!»", "sha256": "0c32da12d748fb0d2cef1bfba50e1d96639b267fb0337bdfb830b9a4e2fc2c33", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3276], "source_xml_sha256": "43907d15ad486259f2122bf3f9399147fa2642a742d7d759d414337557c9d932", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u054-b0108", "text": "En un instant l'échelle fut dressée et appuyée à la balustrade de la galerie inférieure, au-dessus d'un des portails latéraux. La foule des truands poussant de grandes acclamations se pressa au bas pour y monter. Mais Jehan maintint son droit et posa le premier le pied sur les échelons. Le trajet était assez long. La galerie des rois de France est élevée aujourd'hui d'environ soixante pieds au-dessus du pavé. Les onze marches du perron l'exhaussaient encore. Jehan montait lentement, assez empêché de sa lourde armure, d'une main tenant l'échelon, de l'autre son arbalète. Quand il fut au milieu de l'échelle il jeta un coup d'œil mélancolique sur les pauvres argotiers morts, dont le degré était jonché. «Hélas! dit-il, voilà un monceau de cadavres digne du cinquième chant de [[I]]l'Iliade[[/I]]!» Puis il continua de monter. Les truands le suivaient. Il y en avait un sur chaque échelon. À voir s'élever en ondulant dans l'ombre cette ligne de dos cuirassés, on eût dit un serpent à écailles d'acier qui se dressait contre l'église.
